title: Buchanan finds the Mount Hayes base automated and empty of people

tellings.quote: I did Mount Hayes and found out that the equipment was now automated

plain: A former Army sergeant named Lyn Buchanan says that when he took on the target of a base at Mount Hayes, Alaska, he found its equipment had been automated and no people were left there. He tells it as his own work, from one of the assignments he says he carried out.
